summary: Builds the championship team statistics menu. Looks up a team statistics record from a global UI list accessor (via a virtual dispatch through dword_7CD8C0 plus LinkedListIndexedAccessor_f590), clears and frees the menu's existing linked list nodes, re-inserts seven stat category headers, then creates seven formatted UI menu items (label + separator + team data string at offsets 700/828/844/908/924/940/956 from the team record) plus one final separator-only item.

operations.description: Initialize the team statistics string pointer v2 to 0 at function entry.
Dispatch a virtual call through the vtable held by dword_7CD8C0 (offset +28) with argument 21 to obtain the stats source object v3.
If v3 is null, skip the team data lookup entirely.
Call LinkedListIndexedAccessor_f590(v3) to obtain the indexed list accessor v4.
If v4 is null, skip the team data lookup entirely.
If *(v4 + 72) > 0 and the pointer stored at *(v4 + 60) is non-null, dereference it into v6; otherwise v6 is 0.
Set v2 to the const char* stored at *(v6 + 60): the team statistics string record.
result = StateCleanupNotification(this): notify the state cleanup path for this menu object.
If v2 (the team statistics record) is non-null, rebuild the menu content.
Seed the list traversal from this[17] (linked list head); initialize separator buffer v19 from byte_5EA438[0] with v20 = 0 and v21 = 0.
Walk the linked list starting at this[17]: each iteration reads the flag byte at node + 8 and advances to the next pointer at node + 4, stopping when the next pointer is null.
When the node flag is set, free the nested data wrapper (and its inner pointer) via FreeWrapper_7bcf; free the node itself afterwards in every iteration.
Clear the linked list fields this[17], this[18], this[19] and this[20] to 0 after freeing the old list.
Insert seven stat category headers with index -1 via LinkedListInsertWithNodeAllocation: aTeam_1, aFounded, aHeadquarters, aStarts, aPolePositions, aWins, aConstructorCha.
StrlenOverwrite(&v19): recompute the separator buffer length.

For each index 0..6: fetch the label with UIListIndexedAccessor(i), format '%s%s%s' (aSSS_0) into v23 as label + separator + team data string read at v2 + 700/828/844/908/924/940/956 respectively, then create a UI menu item via UIMenuItemCreator(v23, 0, 0, 0, 0).
Format the final separator-only item with the '%s' format (aS_4) into v23, then return UIMenuItemCreator(v23, 0, 0, 0, 0).
When no team statistics record is present, return the stored StateCleanupNotification result.
